Definition: flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light)
BiblicalUsage: Glorify the Lord in the fires, says Isaiah, even His name in the isles of the sea, and Ezekiel is told to burn a third part of the city with fire in the midst of the siege.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fire in Scripture is never only destruction: the same flame that burns the city is the light by which the Lord is glorified in the isles, and God holds both ends of it.
